caution.warningAndCautionPara: ONLY APPROVED PERSONS WITH THE NECESSARY SKILLS MUST BE USED FOR THE MAINTENANCE PROCEDURES IN THIS MANUAL.

levelledPara.para: This Component Maintenance Publication (CMP) gives all the procedures supplied by the manufacturer for use in the workshop, so that all persons can repair and fully overhaul the component.

The technical content of this document has successfully passed a verification process on testing, inspection, disassembly and assembly procedures. The supplier declares the content of this document accurate and adequate.

The publication gives maintenance on the component in a workshop. It does not define or show the level of maintenance for all special units, but gives all the procedures necessary to let the person do a test, disassemble, clean, check and assemble a panel which has been rejected from serviceable use. The manual does not give maintenance on the component when it is installed on the aircraft.
Only approved persons are allowed to do the maintenance procedures given in this manual.

Where the data or procedures specified in this manual are different from those specified by the regulatory agency which controls operation of your aircraft, obey the data and procedures of the regulatory authority.

This publication contains:
Technical data for the component,
Maintenance and repair procedures,
An Illustrated Parts Data (IPD) with data for the component parts. The IPD Figure and item number identifies in all sections of the manual.
Make sure that the publication contains the information applicable to your component. Look on the Title Page for the part number.
If it is necessary to identify a part or find a part number, refer to the IPD, which has an introduction to show the procedure.
The instructions in this publication must be used for all component maintenance. Read all the applicable WARNINGS and CAUTIONS before you do the work on the component.

This publication will be updated as required by revisions, Service Bulletin can be issued separately. Their effect on the publication will be made evident by reissue of the Service Bulletins List as applicable.
These adjuncts to the text are expressed by these headings:
Read all the applicable WARNINGS and CAUTIONS before to start any maintenance instruction.

warning.warningAndCautionPara: WARNINGS GIVE INSTRUCTIONS TO THE USE OF MATERIALS, PROCEDURES OR LIMITS THAT CAN CAUSE INJURY OR DEATH OF PERSONS IF NOT CORRECTLY FOLLOWED.

caution.warningAndCautionPara: CAUTIONS GIVE INSTRUCTIONS TO THE USE OF MATERIALS, PROCEDURES OR LIMITS THAT CAN CAUSE DAMAGE TO THE EQUIPMENT IF NOT CORRECTLY FOLLOWED.

note.notePara: Notes give instructions to follow that can make the job easier.

levelledPara.para: All result data and illustrations in this publication are the last revision available at the time of printing. Safran Seats (Safran Seats France) supplies updates to this publication when necessary. When Safran Seats (Safran Seats France) issue a modification to units included in this publication, Safran Seats (Safran Seats France) will revise the publication to include the information.

When there is a change, each updating gives the full instructions about the page number of the pages which must be replaced, added or removed. Revised texts or new texts are found with a vertical black line in the margin.
Service Bulletins can be issued separately. They will be included into the CMP and IPD at the next issue and will be shown in the TECHNICAL STANDARD RECORD.
